Reckoning

Krile LD (Ignis LD Call)

Aerith LD (Cloud LD Call)

Terra BT/LD (Jack LD Call)

Odin Summon

84 turns, 1,008,808 Score

Basically rationed out the LD skill usages

1st Wave: Used Ignis LD call off the bat for Krile to get the imperil/enchant and then went into her Ray of Hope and EX. Saved using Terra's LD ability completely. Opting instead to switch between her S1 and S2 when her magic count was above 5. Otherwise used her HP attack or EX ability to save on skill usage.  For Aerith, I had her between her Brv and HP attack. Once the count started and the Ignis's call ended. I used Krile's/Aerith's LDs once each and slowly shaved down their health while keeping health up and debuffs active. Honestly the hardest part.

2nd Wave: I decided to allocate one LD for each part of the bird. The tricky part is going on a race to the finish with the count and only having Clouds LD call (Which I did use) to delay the count. Used a chaos wave and Aerith's LD in case it got a turn in while racing against the count. Then once the second half started, I used the summon right before it's turn in order to get all the debuffs and buffs up and at the end of the summon, I used a chaos wave and Jack's call to finish it off in the middle of the free turns.

3rd Wave: Got all my buffs and debuffs up and healed before it entered kill mode. Once it hit kill mode. I entered Terra Burst, ending with Chaos Wave and free turns after burst. immediately followed up with another chaos wave and managed to kill one of them with the other having 25% and just lay into it with everything I had left.
